Title: Add item to cart
Objective: Verify an item can be added to the cart.
Preconditions: Signed-in user with an empty cart. Product Desk Lamp costs 25.00.
Steps:
1. Open the Desk Lamp product page.
2. Select Add to cart.
Expected Result: Cart shows 1 x Desk Lamp. Subtotal is 25.00.

Title: Quantity 0 rejected
Objective: Verify a quantity of 0 is rejected.
Steps:
1. Change the quantity to 0.
2. Select Update.
Expected Result: Message "Quantity must be between 1 and 10" is shown. Quantity stays 1.

Title: Quantity 11 rejected by API
Objective: Verify the API rejects a quantity above the maximum of 10.
Expected Result: 400 response with error QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE. Quantity stays 1.

Title: Valid code reduces total
Objective: Verify a valid percentage code reduces the order total.
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is 80.00. Code SAVE10 (10% off, minimum order 50.00) is active.
Steps:
1. Enter SAVE10 in the discount field.
2. Select Apply.
Expected Result: Discount line shows -8.00. Order total is 72.00.

Title: Second code rejected
Objective: Verify only one discount code can be used per order.
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is 80.00 with SAVE10 applied.
Steps:
1. Enter WELCOME5 in the discount field.
2. Select Apply.
Expected Result: Message "Only one discount code can be used per order" is shown. SAVE10 stays applied. Order total stays 72.00.

Title: Code at minimum order value
Objective: Verify a code is accepted when the subtotal equals the minimum order value.
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is exactly 50.00. Code SAVE10 has a minimum order of 50.00.
Steps:
1. Enter SAVE10 in the discount field.
2. Select Apply.
Expected Result: Code is applied. Order total is 45.00.

Title: Declined card keeps cart
Objective: Verify a declined card shows an error and keeps the cart.
Preconditions: User is on the payment step. Order total is 72.00 with SAVE10 applied.
Steps:
1. Enter the test card that is always declined.
2. Select Pay.
Expected Result: Message "Your card was declined" is shown. User stays on the payment step. Cart and SAVE10 are kept. No order is created.

Title: Double submit charges once
Objective: Verify a double submit creates one order and one charge.
Preconditions: User is on the payment step with valid card details entered.
Steps: 1. Select Pay twice within one second.
Expected Result: One order is created. The card is charged once.

Title: Paid order is locked
Objective: Verify a paid order can't be edited.
Steps: 1. Send PATCH /v1/orders/{id} to change an item quantity.
Expected Result: 409 response with error ORDER_LOCKED. Order is unchanged.
